brand_core.mission: Remind people that milk is a timeless, wholesome staple worth reaching for.
brand_core.positioning: The iconic, culturally-fluent voice of milk — nostalgic but never dated, playful but trustworthy.
brand_core.brand_role: A friendly cultural participant that shows up in the moments people already care about, milk in hand.
brand_core.tone: Playful, warm, self-aware, pop-culture-literate, never preachy or clinical.
brand_core.visual_identity: The milk mustache. Clean, bold, high-contrast. Classic wordmark 'got milk?'.

segments: Gen Z (16-26) driving culture on TikTok
Millennial parents nostalgic for the original campaign
Health-curious young adults rethinking what they drink
audience.culture: Very online, meme-fluent, values authenticity and brands that don't try too hard.
audience.media_behavior: TikTok-first, Instagram Reels, ambient X. Skips ads, rewards native participation.

category.category_context: Dairy is defending relevance against plant alternatives and functional beverages; nostalgia and authenticity are milk's edge.

channels.guidance: Lead organic-native; participate in trends rather than interrupt them.

messaging.claims_rules: No medical, nutritional-superiority, or health-outcome claims. Keep benefits general and lifestyle-oriented.

do_not: Invent health, nutrition, or medical claims
Put words in the mouths of real athletes or celebrities
Imply official endorsement that hasn't been secured
Make superiority claims vs. named competitors
governance.approval_matrix: Cultural Intelligence Strategist reviews all signals before action. Legal reviews any claim-adjacent content.

past_learnings: Native trend participation outperforms polished ads
Nostalgia angles overperform with both Gen Z and parents
avoid: Chasing trends the brand can't credibly join
